summary_en: 185,000 shares (2.14% of shares outstanding) acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-13 at ¥4,840/share ceiling; total authorization ¥895.4M; shares to be used for convertible bond and warrant conversions.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Purchase of Treasury Shares via Off-Exchange Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-13, AMIYA Corporation's board approved the acquisition of up to 185,000 treasury shares (2.14% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) via ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange transaction. The purchase will be executed at the 2026-08-12 closing price of ¥4,840 per share, with a total authorization ceiling of ¥895.4M. Results will be announced on 2026-08-13 following the 08:45 trade window close. The company stated the acquisition is intended to improve capital efficiency and enable flexible capital allocation responsive to changing business conditions. A portion of the acquired shares will be used to settle conversions and exercises of unsecured convertible bonds (first tranche) and warrants (third tranche) issued under third-party allocations announced on 2026-02-12. The order is limited to the specified trading session only; partial or full non-execution is possible depending on market conditions.
